parameters.content:
## Odoo Product Agent v4 — GPT-5 PDF Reading

FIX v4: Replaced n8n native PDF extractor (which fails on table-heavy PDFs) with GPT-5 reading the PDF directly via OpenAI API.

WORKFLOW:
• Excel: native parsing (fast, free)
• PDF: GPT-5 reads file directly (handles complex tables, images, layouts)

parameters.jsonBody: ={"model":"gpt-5","max_completion_tokens":4000,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"file","file":{"filename":"{{ $json.fileName }}","file_data":"data:application/pdf;base64,{{ $json.base64 }}"}},{"type":"text","text":"Extract all products from this PDF document. For each product extract: name, SKU/model number/code, price in USD, brand. Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown), one object per product. Format: [{\"Name\":\"product name\",\"SKU\":\"model or code\",\"Price\":number,\"Brand\":\"brand if visible\"}]. If a field is unknown use empty string for text or 0 for price. Return ONLY the JSON array."}]}]}

parameters.text:
=You are a Product Categorization Agent for Odoo ERP.

MANDATORY FIRST STEP: Call "Get Odoo Categories" tool first. Use ONLY those categories. Never invent categories.

PRODUCT DATA:
{{ $json.products_json }}

TASKS:
1. Extract every product (Excel rows or already-extracted PDF data).
2. Extract SKU/Code (look for: SKU, Ref, Code, default_code, Item No, Part No, Model No). Empty string if none.
3. Extract Product Name.
4. Extract Brand or empty string.
5. Extract list_price or 0 (look for Price, Cost, Value).
6. Assign best matching Odoo category.
7. Return Category_ID as integer from Odoo.

OUTPUT: pure JSON array only, no markdown:
[{"SKU":"","Product_Name":"","Category":"","Category_ID":0,"Brand":"","list_price":0}]

Return ONLY the JSON array.

options.systemMessage: Categorize products for Odoo. Call Get Odoo Categories first. Return only JSON array with integer Category_ID.
